This one hasn't been translated yet (the MTL is shit), so I figured I might as well give cleaning the bubbles a go. So, many, bubbles.

Removed the text except for the onomatopoeia outside of bubbles. I also left the hearts in place so any future work can just use them.

Two panels with the hiragana for "a" remain because they are inside see-through bubbles on top of her hair. I tried. Pages 11 and 39. Also, someone else will have to do the front-page. I can't do color.

Feel free to use for translations. Sorry if you were hoping for a translation and are left disappointed, I guess.

Support the creator.
